title: Alichta-Flour Ethiopian Flatbread with Zesty Twist
description: A traditional Ethiopian flatbread recipe with a crunchy fried twist and a zesty kick. Perfect for any meal or snack.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, mix together Alichta flour and water to form a dough.
2. Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
3. Divide the dough into 6-8 equal pieces.
4. Roll out each piece into a thin circle.
5. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
6. Fry the flatbread for 2-3 minutes on each side, until crispy and golden brown.
7. Brush the flatbread with zesty sauce and sprinkle with Ethiopian spices.
